item.description:

item.title: SLAC researchers find proof of altermagnetism, a new magnetic phase
item.description:
📝 Antiferromagnets have alternating electronic spins (up-down-up-down) that cancel each other out, producing no net magnetic effect. But in recent years, researchers have noticed that some materials don’t fit neatly into either category. ” That missing piece was experimental evidence of chirality in an altermagnetic candidate material.
🔗 Read more: https://www6.slac.stanford.edu/news/2026-10-29-slac-researchers-find-proof-altermagnetism-new-magnetic-phase
